Operations reference 058/014; issuer account Nacre-75; dispatch 20265814.
PAGE 01 / EXTRACTED TEXT
A pension mandate has reviewed the agenda with its stewardship team. Its instructions will be routed through the custodian; portfolio reporting material is supplied for administrative background only.

The issuer has convened its Special General Meeting; shareholders may submit proxy voting instructions through their custodian.

Ballot processing is contingent on the following step: the voting holder must provide a valid power of attorney before instructions are accepted.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

Ballot processing is contingent on the following step: the voting investor must recall loaned securities before exercising voting rights.

Ballot processing is contingent on the following step: the beneficial holder must complete additional voting registration with the meeting agent.

The receiving agent has not established whether share blocking is a prerequisite; that part of the current schedule is unavailable.

Ballot processing is contingent on the following step: a participating voter must satisfy the additional professional-investor eligibility condition.
[End of extracted operative section]

Operations reference 037/004; issuer account Nacre-54; dispatch 20263704.
EVENT INFORMATION / CURRENT TERMS
This is a service summary prepared for the beneficial holder. Attendance arrangements, corporate records and account reconciliation are distinct from the voting requirements set out in the operative paragraphs.
The issuer has convened its Court Meeting; shareholders may submit proxy voting instructions through their custodian.
Whether the additional professional-investor voting restriction will be required is still unconfirmed; the operative condition is missing from this notice.
There is no requirement for a restriction on split voting under the current voting terms.
Whether recall of securities on loan will be required is still unconfirmed; the operative condition is missing from this notice.
Under the operative service terms, The intermediary is required to disclose the beneficial owner identity as a condition of voting.
Under the operative service terms, The nominee is required to supply a dated certificate confirming its holdings to lodge votes.
Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

Operations reference 021/028; issuer account Nacre-38; dispatch 20262128.

This is a service summary prepared for the beneficial holder. Attendance arrangements, corporate records and account reconciliation are distinct from the voting requirements set out in the operative paragraphs.

The issuer has convened its Annual General Meeting; shareholders may submit proxy voting instructions through their custodian.

Whether a certificate confirming holdings will be required is still unconfirmed; the operative condition is missing from this notice.

Under the operative service terms, Votes attached to an account are required to be cast identically because split voting is prohibited.

Whether beneficial-owner identity disclosure will be required is still unconfirmed; the operative condition is missing from this notice.

The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.
Regards, Operations
